label: PF Backlog 599
title: API-first standard (ADR-0007): assess API need per capability; where needed, expose a secured API for internal + external consumers
body: ADR-0007. For each capability: do a proper need assessment for an API; where a need exists (internal or external consumer), expose a secured API surface (authn, authz/tenant scope, validation, quotas, audit, versioned contract). Admin capabilities get an admin-scoped API. Where an API is provided, tooling/CLIs become clients of it. No blind API: if no consumer needs one, record the justification at Gate 1. New logic in Go; Python routes thin.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Leverage core/capability_bridge.py and core/capability_packs.py as the registry; formalize each PF capability behind a secured HTTP API (authn/z via existing capability vectors). CLI/tooling becomes a thin client of the API. Codify ADR-0007 as docs/adr/0007-api-first.md plus an enforcement check (lint/CI) verifying every pack entry has an API route registered.
